exceptions.rationale: The tenant application and public verification surfaces are intentionally Internet-facing behind TLS, WAF, and the public application load balancer.
Server-rendered Web requests use the tenant public API origin; the exception is limited to outbound TCP 443 through redundant NAT gateways.
The API must reach tenant-selected OAuth and verification providers with dynamic addresses; the exception is limited to outbound TCP 443.
The Worker must crawl approved tenant URLs and call approved publication providers with dynamic addresses; this rule is limited to outbound TCP 443.
The Worker must crawl approved tenant HTTP URLs before redirect enforcement can be observed; this rule is limited to outbound TCP 80.
Application Load Balancer access-log delivery supports only S3-managed encryption keys, so using the platform CMK would break log delivery.
